div.div: صَنَّاجٌ A player with [or upon] the صَنْج, meaning [the cymbal, and also] the stringed instrument so called: and in like manner ↓ صَنَّاجَةٌ : (L:) but this latter has an intensive signification [meaning an excellent player with, or upon, the صنج]: (Har p. 617:) and signifies also a woman having [or playing with] a صَنْج, as in a verse cited voce جَذَا in art. جذو [where it evidently means a female player with cymbals]. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
